items.description: This tutorial teaches you how to record and edit voiceovers in Audacity for professional results. You’ll learn to optimize recording settings, clean up mistakes, and apply effects like EQ, noise reduction, and compression. The course is suitable for content creators, podcasters, and video editors aiming to improve their audio production. With step-by-step guidance, this course is perfect for beginners and intermediates looking to enhance voiceovers using free software.

This tutorial explores fundamental sound generation and synthesis techniques using MSP in Max. Through 23 videos, you’ll learn to build synthesis patches, design GUIs, create LFOs, and transform MSP patches into standalone devices. The course is ideal for intermediate Max users aiming to develop audio DSP and synthesis skills. Key topics include working with oscillators, filters, modulation routing, and integrating GUI designs. Led by Phelan Kane, it offers practical knowledge for both music and multimedia projects.

items.human_name: Programming and Recording Drums in Ableton Live
items.description: This tutorial teaches you how to program and record drums in Ableton Live 12, covering everything from basic setup to advanced techniques for creating professional drum tracks. Whether you’re a beginner or an intermediate user, you’ll learn essential skills like configuring audio settings, navigating Session and Arrangement Views, creating and editing MIDI clips, building custom drum racks, and applying humanization techniques for realistic drum patterns. Led by Anna Lakatos, an Ableton Certified Trainer and experienced music producer, this course is ideal for producers of all levels aiming to

items.human_name: Recording and Editing Vocals in Ableton Live
items.description: In this tutorial, Anna, an Ableton Certified Trainer, demonstrates how to record and edit vocals in Ableton Live. The session covers setting up your audio interface and microphone, configuring latency settings, and managing take lanes for comping multiple vocal recordings. Anna also guides through editing techniques, including applying fades, organizing takes, and creating artificial harmonies using duplicated and transposed vocal tracks. The tutorial concludes with tips for mixing harmonies and using effects to enhance the final sound.

items.human_name: Recording Bass Guitar with Live Lite
items.description: This tutorial teaches how to record and mix bass guitar using Ableton Live Lite. You’ll learn to set up an audio interface, apply amp simulations with GK Amplification and Amplitube 5, and use techniques like compression, sidechain compression, and time correction for a clean mix. Led by Arthur Carneiro, it’s ideal for musicians new to recording or those looking to enhance their bass mixing skills using Live Lite and VST plugins. The course covers everything from recording to finalizing tracks for a professional result.

items.human_name: Writing Harmonies and Melodies in Ableton Live
items.description: In this tutorial, Anna, an Ableton Certified Trainer, demonstrates how to sequence harmonies and melodies in Ableton Live. The session covers setting up MIDI tracks, selecting instruments like Simpler, and using features like the scale tool to ensure notes stay in key. Anna shows techniques for recording chords, adjusting basslines, adding an arpeggiator, and creating variations in the melody. The tutorial emphasizes creative recycling of clips, layering, and utilizing Arrangement View for a polished final arrangement.

items.human_name: Recording Audio from Youtube in Audacity
items.description: This tutorial guides you on how to record audio from YouTube using Audacity. It covers the process of setting up Audacity to capture system sound, configuring your recording settings, and editing the captured audio. The tutorial is ideal for those who want to record and manipulate audio for personal projects. It is accessible for users at all levels, providing a step-by-step walkthrough to ensure high-quality audio recordings from online sources.

items.human_name: Understanding Indian rhythm through simple algorithms
items.description: This tutorial explores South Indian Carnatic rhythms and their application in music production using algorithms. You’ll learn to recite simple konnakol phrases, create rhythmic algorithms, and translate them into Max patches. The course covers key Carnatic concepts like Tala, Jhati, and Nadai. Led by Dom Aversano, it’s designed for those interested in combining traditional Indian rhythms with computer music. Perfect for beginners exploring algorithmic rhythm creation and cross-cultural music techniques.

This masterclass teaches electronic musicians how to write for the violin and integrate orchestral instruments in their compositions. It covers standard violin articulations, realistic VST programming using tools like Spitfire's BBC Symphony Orchestra and SWAM's Violin, and best practices for writing idiomatic violin music. The course is ideal for composers, arrangers, and producers who want to achieve realistic string sounds in their projects. Led by Helen Noir, the course combines technical violin knowledge with practical music production tips.

items.human_name: Recording Acoustic Guitar Using Ableton Live Lite
items.description: This tutorial covers recording acoustic guitar using Ableton Live Lite. You'll learn how to set up your audio interface and microphone, record and edit guitar tracks, and apply effects like EQ and compression. It is suitable for beginners and intermediate users looking to improve their recording techniques. Topics include configuring inputs, microphone placement, time/pitch corrections, and enhancing your sound with effects. This tutorial is ideal for anyone interested in producing high-quality acoustic guitar recordings with Ableton Live Lite.

items.human_name: Mastering Audio Effects and Creative Automation in Ableton Live
items.description: In this tutorial, Anna, an Ableton Certified Trainer, demonstrates how to apply effects and automation in Ableton Live. She covers adding reverb, saturation, EQ, and compression to drums, bass, and vocals, using return tracks for efficient CPU usage. Anna also explains creating vocal effects with send/return tracks and automating parameters like filter cutoffs and delay settings for transitions. This session highlights practical tips for improving your mix and achieving polished results by using automation creatively in your tracks.

items.human_name: Turning your song into an Ableton Live looping performance
items.description: This course teaches you how to create a live looping performance in Ableton Live using techniques like MIDI mapping, resampling, and follow actions. Designed for drummers and live performers, it covers exporting from Arrangement to Session View, building a CPU-efficient set, and using tools like Max for Live devices. You’ll follow along with Vicky O’Neon as she demonstrates using her own track “Cold As.” This course is ideal for performers looking to integrate Ableton Live into their live sets.

items.human_name: Recording Vocals on a Backing Track Using Audacity
items.description: This tutorial teaches you how to record vocals over a backing track using Audacity. You’ll learn to set up your recording environment, record multiple takes, edit and compile the best parts, and apply effects like EQ and compression for clarity. It’s ideal for aspiring musicians, podcasters, and voice-over artists looking to improve their recording skills with free software. The course covers everything from room acoustics to finalizing your vocal track for a professional sound.

items.human_name: Recording Electric Guitar with Live Lite
items.description: This tutorial teaches how to record electric guitar in Ableton Live Lite using free amp simulation plugins. Led by Arthur Carneiro, it covers setting up an audio interface, recording multiple takes, applying effects like EQ and compression, and arranging tracks for a polished mix. The course is designed for guitarists and producers using Ableton Live Lite and provides practical tips for enhancing guitar recordings with plugins like Bluecat Free Amps and Black Rooster Cypress TT.

This tutorial covers vocal mixing techniques in Audacity using Antares and Valhalla plugins. You’ll learn to apply EQ, autotune, de-essing, reverb, and echo, as well as creating parallel channels for a rich vocal mix. Ideal for producers and vocalists aiming to enhance their recordings with professional-quality mixing techniques. Suitable for those with basic vocal recording and editing knowledge.

This trumpet masterclass is designed for electronic musicians interested in writing for orchestral instruments. It covers trumpet articulations, composing realistic trumpet lines using VSTs, and communicating effectively with trumpet players. The course also explores different trumpet styles like orchestral, jazz, and soul. Led by Helen Noir, this class is ideal for composers, arrangers, and producers wanting to achieve lifelike trumpet sounds in their projects using tools like SWAM Solo Brass. Suitable for both live musicians and VST programming.

This tutorial teaches how to create dynamic basslines using Ableton Live’s Analog Synth. You’ll learn to set up MIDI devices, edit MIDI clips, and apply sound design techniques like using oscillators, filters, and envelopes. The course is perfect for beginners and aspiring producers aiming to enhance their music production skills. It covers everything from MIDI routing to adding automation for movement in your basslines, making it an ideal guide for those new to synth-based bass creation in Ableton Live.

items.human_name: Creative Vocal Looping With BOSS Loop Stations
items.description: This tutorial teaches how to creatively use BOSS Loop Stations for live vocal looping. You'll learn beatboxing, audio routing, layering loops, and structuring performances. Ideal for vocalists, loop artists, and music producers interested in live looping techniques. Led by Grace Savage, a UK beatboxing champion and electronic-pop artist, the course offers practical skills to enhance live performances using voice and live recordings. Suitable for beginners and those exploring the potential of BOSS Loop Stations in musical composition and performance.

items.human_name: Sketch Musical Ideas with Ableton Note
items.description: This tutorial covers how to use Ableton Note, an iOS app for sketching musical ideas. You’ll learn how to configure Note, build beats, sample sounds, and export projects to Ableton Live via Ableton Cloud. The course is ideal for beginners, sound designers, and music producers interested in exploring creative workflows on mobile devices. Led by Ableton Certified Trainer Phelan Kane, it offers hands-on guidance for using Note’s tools to capture and develop ideas efficiently.

items.human_name: Treating Synth Bass in Ableton Live
items.description: This tutorial teaches how to treat a bass synth in Ableton Live using native effects. You’ll learn to apply stereo separation, mid-side EQ, saturation, and gain structuring to enhance bass presence and clarity. Techniques like sidechain compression are also covered to prevent frequency clashes with drums. Ideal for producers focused on bass-heavy genres like EDM and hip-hop, the course offers practical mixing tips for achieving a solid, well-balanced low-end in your tracks.

items.description: With "Semantic Color Palette", you can improve your workflow by using a semantic color management system. How does it work? You define a set of meaningful identifiers for colors, representing where/how each color is used (e.g. "buttonBackground"), and not the colors themselves (e.g. "darkBrown"). Then, in palettes, you map each identifier to an actual color value. The elements where colors are to be applied never directly refer to actual, specific colors, but only to semantic color ids. items.human_name: Intro to Rigging Models in Blender
items.description: Prepare your 3D models for animation by learning the fundamentals of rigging in Blender! Rigging is a fundamental technique for 3D animation by which one creates a skeletal-like armature that can be manipulated to move parts of the 3D mesh around. While working hands-on with a model in Blender, you’ll discover everything required for rigging – from setting up the “bones” to weight painting and controlling which parts of the mesh are affected by each bone. By the end, you’ll have the foundations you’ll need to master rigging any kind of 3D model and expand your skills in creating custom assets.

You’ll learn how to use common 3D modeling features offered by Polybrush to sculpt meshes into different shapes, as well as paint & blend textures onto those meshes. With the added addition of being able to paint Prefabs directly onto the mesh, you’ll discover how to use these tools to quickly create levels for game projects and boost your ability to prototype and make custom game assets. items.description: Master texturing in Blender by learning how to use UV maps! UV mapping – a process by which you “unwrap” a 3D model into a flat surface – offers creators an easy way to paint complex textures. While creating several models, you’ll learn a variety of techniques for not only creating UV maps from different shapes, but how to adjust those maps to suit your material’s needs. Regardless of the sort of model you’re making, skills in UV mapping will provide you with the foundations you need to customize your 3D graphics to your exact specifications. You will learn how to: Apply textures to an object

This playlist smells like salt, sweat, and midnight. Brass-heavy salsa that moves you without asking permission, vintage mambo, bossa nova that pours like slow coffee, tango with an edge, and guitars that seduce without saying a word. From the beaches of Brazil to the streets of San Juan — if your project needs fire, this is its soundtrack.
Layer gentle winds through quiet fields, the distant chatter of a contented barnyard, and the steady rhythm of rain on a farmhouse roof. This is the authentic, pastoral calm of the countryside.

On The Road is a pack of 12 tracks built for stories in motion — documentaries, travel content, corporate narratives, and cinematic journeys. From driving techno-pop and heroic fanfares to world beat grooves and suspenseful undercurrents, it covers the full emotional arc of adventure and ambition. Bold, dynamic, and globally inspired, this pack keeps your audience moving forward.

A curated collection of 20 atmospheric sounds perfect for enhancing interviews and narrative projects. Features vintage vibraphone accents, subtle whooshes, library ambience, sci-fi tones, and delicate glass sounds. Ideal for documentaries, podcasts, or adding vintage/ethereal flavor to stories.

This collection of 12 ethereal tracks is your sonic key to mystical realms, blending delicate fantasy tones, serene spiritual hymns, and playful childhood wonder to score everything from enchanted trailers and magical gameplay to heartwarming animated stories. Unlock the door to your next creative adventure.

Classic lullabies, gentle music boxes, campfire melodies, and dreamy arrangements — from Brahms to Twinkle Twinkle — everything here is designed to slow the world down and ease little ones into sleep. Warm, tender, and timelessly comforting.

Gentle whispers from children and adults, soft tooth brushing and hair brushing, paper tearing, fabric rustling, curtain slides, a trickling shower, shaving cream spray, and even a wire brush scraping wood — all captured up close. Perfect for relaxation videos, sleep aids, sensory content, or any creator looking to trigger that satisfying, brain-tingling response

From footsteps across every surface — cement, concrete, wood, dirt, leaves, metal, and stairs — to the sounds of doors opening, closing, locking, and knocking. Plus typing on keyboards, clicking mice, pouring drinks, turning book pages, sitting in chairs, lighting matches and cigarettes, breaking glass, running water, jingling keys, clapping hands, body falls, and even a fly buzzing around a microphone.

This electro pop music playlist features a dynamic mix of uplifting, modern house, trap, ethereal, electronic, and inspirational dance music. With a fusion of different genres, this playlist offers a diverse range of tracks that are perfect for creating a lively and energetic atmosphere. Whether you're looking to get pumped up for a workout or simply want to elevate your mood, this playlist is sure to keep you moving and grooving!

Authentic female vocal recordings covering the full range of human expression — laughter, distress, effort, reaction, and everything in between. From a witch's cackle and a hailing whistle to crying, struggling, and genuine human moments, this pack gives your characters a real voice. Essential for games, animations, and any production that needs women to sound human.

"Robots in Action" is a set of robotic motion and servo sound effects for sci-fi. It features precise servo whirrs, heavy android footsteps, and the whines of mechanical activation—creating the sound of obedient drones, patrolling sentries, and intricate robotic articulation in motion.

Epic Quest is a pack of 12 cinematic tracks built for heroes, battles, and worlds bigger than life. From thunderous orchestral builds and superhero fanfares to sweeping drones and bittersweet emotional moments, it covers every beat of an epic narrative arc. Designed for trailers, blockbusters, and high-stakes storytelling — this is the sound of legends in the making.

Robot morphs, ratcheting mechanisms, diesel engines, band saws, hammers on metal, cranking levers, and servo chirps — every sound here has weight, function, and texture. Perfect for industrial sequences, robotics, workshop scenes, or any production that needs the satisfying reality of machinery at work.

Street Scene & Urban Pulse is 10 tracks that live where the city never sleeps. Funky Memphis horns, hip hop beats, pulsating electronica, and lo-fi menace — this pack captures every side of urban energy, from the swagger of a fashion runway to the tension of a late-night investigation. Gritty, confident, and impossible to ignore.

Animals: Small Mammals is 20 recordings from the smaller, scrappier side of the animal kingdom — chihuahua growls, monkey screeches, rat packs, mouse squeaks, squirrel chirps, bats screeching, a rabbit in distress, otters, guinea pigs, and even a giant rat growl. Small in size, big in character. Perfect for nature scenes, horror, comedy, and everything in between.

Retro Transmission is 20 sounds from the golden age of broadcasting — vintage radios switching on, analog dials tuning across bands, ham radio operators, TV static, dead channels, channel surfing, and rotary dial clicks. From a 1938 Stromberg console to a flickering CRT screen, this pack captures the warm, crackling imperfection of an era when signals had to be found

This is a pack of 31 uplifting electronic tracks built for content that needs energy, optimism, and a sun-soaked vibe. From breezy tropical house and future bass to deep house grooves and urban electro, every track is designed to motivate, elevate, and keep things moving. Perfect for travel videos, fitness content, commercials, and anything that deserves a feel-good soundtrack.

No stadiums. No ego. Just 25 tracks of honest, scrappy, heart-on-sleeve indie rock. From jangly, carefree guitar strums and bouncy retro vibes to moody, yearning anthems for those cold sober nights. Driving rhythms, warm distortion, and melodies that stick with you long after the song ends.

Solo Cello Meditations is a curated collection of 10 classical works performed for solo cello, drawing from the repertoire of Bach, Saint-Saëns, Tchaikovsky, Rossini, Haydn, and Beethoven. From elegant baroque suites and romantic sonatas to deeply expressive laments, this pack offers timeless musical depth for film, documentary, and any production requiring the singular intimacy of the cello.

Haunted Harmonies is a symphony of shadow and spectacle, merging brutal orchestral force with eerie, supernatural atmosphere. From apocalyptic battles and cursed revelations to sinister magic shows and heroic struggles against the void, this collection is forged for epic horror, dark fantasy, and trailers where light fights to survive the fall.

Animals: Huge Mammals is 10 recordings from the largest and loudest creatures on earth — lion growls, tiger roars, elephant trumpets, bear growls, humpback whale calls, buffalo grunts, and wild boar in a forest. Raw, powerful, and unmistakably alive. For any scene that needs the presence of something much bigger than you.

"Analog Horizons in VHS" is a retro synth & rock set for gritty, vintage sci-fi. This collection captures the raw, pulsing energy of 80s-inspired synthtracks and confident guitar riffs—perfect for analog spacecraft, low-tech cybernetics, and cassette-future adventures. Think cathode-ray mysteries and synthwave heroics.

" Step through the portal. Somewhere, a temple bell rings — once, then silence. The forest breathes. Magic stirs in the spaces between sounds: a distant coyote's call, wind threading through desert stone, the thunder of hooves across open ground, a shooting star dissolving into the dark. This is the sound of worlds waiting to be walked. "

Active Aura is 20 sound effects built for creators who make content that moves — gym ambiences, boxing training, jump rope, karate workouts, running footsteps, weight room clangs, stair climbers, and the satisfying exhale after a hard set. Whether you're producing fitness videos, sports content, or workout reels, this pack gives your edits the energy and authenticity your audience can feel.

Demonic cat wails, ghostly breathing, creature growls, evil insect swarms, and zombie moans that crawl under your skin and stay there. Burnt forest ambiences, glass drones, supernatural laughter, and things feeding in the dark — every track is designed to make your audience feel like something is already in the room.

From bittersweet solo piano and brooding western regret to spacey, contemplative drones and subtle romantic undertones, it’s the essential score for character-driven dramas, festival shorts, and narratives that thrive on raw, emotional authenticity. Tell the quiet stories.

"Drone & Swarm Behavior" is a pack of mechanical and insectoid sound effects for sci-fi. It features the propeller hum of micro-drones, the unsettling buzz of alien swarms, and the servo clicks of small robots, creating the sonic presence of autonomous machines and hive-minded threats.

Need to build a world of crime and suspense? This layers the harsh clang of jail—distant screams, klaxon buzzers, jangling keys—with the focused quiet of a police station and the sterile hum of a forensic lab. The constant buzz of a dot matrix printer, sharp radio chatter, and unsettling musical drones complete the gritty, procedural atmosphere.

Beginnings are tender, hesitant, often uncertain — pianos and strings whispering doubt, loss, or longing. Then, gradually, something shifts. Layers accumulate. Percussion enters. Melodies rise. Hope doesn't arrive suddenly — it builds. These tracks understand that healing, grief, love, and recovery take time. Perfect for narratives that respect emotional complexity and the slow work of becoming whole.

Need to build a tense medical drama? This delivers the flatlining heart monitor, sharp ER radio chatter, the sterile hum of vintage equipment, and the tense quiet of an empty hospital room. Layer in every beep, breath, and distant voice to create unparalleled realism.

This pack delivers the intense sounds of shock and fear—sharp gasps, panicked whispers, and full-blown terror screams from both adults and children. It's your essential toolkit for scenes of sudden crowd distress and horror.

Sadness is 41 tracks that don't flinch. Solo pianos, lamenting strings, and cinematic atmospheres built for the moments in your story that actually hurt — grief, loss, heartbreak, and the kind of quiet that follows tragedy. From Satie's Gymnopédies to original film scores, this pack goes deep. For creators who know that the most powerful scenes don't need action — they need truth.

Rapid-fire laser weapons, stun guns, and sci-fi blaster shots. Massive space battle ambiences filled with fighters, explosions, and constant laser fire. Spaceship fly-bys, hyperspace exits, and heavy cruiser movement. Cyber impacts, digital crashes, jumps, and futuristic interface hits. Ready to unleash full-scale sci-fi combat in your next project?

The Syntronik SAM is based on the Oberheim SEM synth. Manufactured from 1974-1979, the Synthesizer Expander Module, or “SEM,” is a single voice module containing two variable waveshape oscillators that are mixed together into a 2-pole state variable filter that provides four different filter modes: high pass, band pass, low pass and notch. The SEM state variable filter is probably the second most famous filter in synth history after the iconic Bob Moog transistor ladder filter. The SEM 2-pole filter has a gentler roll off slope at 12dB per octave than the Moog 4-pole filter at 24dB per octave.

The SEM state variable filter is probably the second most famous filter in synth history after the iconic Bob Moog transistor ladder filter. The SEM 2-pole filter has a gentler roll off slope at 12dB per octave than the Moog 4-pole filter at 24dB per octave.

items.human_name: Docker and Kubernetes: The Big Picture
items.description: Docker and Kubernetes are transforming the application landscape - and for good reason. This course is the perfect way to get yourself – and your teams – up to speed and ready to take your first steps.

items.human_name: Managing Apps on Kubernetes with Istio
items.description: Istio lets you manage, secure, and observe the communication between distributed software components. Learn how the service mesh architecture builds on Docker and Kubernetes to provide seamless control over how your services talk to each other.

items.human_name: Kubernetes for Developers: Moving to the Cloud
items.description: Learn how to move your Kubernetes app to the cloud. You will see how to create and update a cluster with your app on AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud. You will also learn how to determine the appropriate cloud option for your application.
Kubernetes is the most important container management technology in the world. This course teaches you the theory and practical skills required to get you up and running as fast as possible.

Kubernetes has emerged as the de facto standard for building and operating applications in the cloud. In this session, Kubernetes expert Nigel Poulton will help you understand why Kubernetes was created, why it's vital and why it's a game-changer.

Kubernetes custom resources provide a powerful means of extending the built-in functionality of Kubernetes. In this course, you will learn how you can use custom resources to tailor Kubernetes to the needs of your application and organization.
This course will teach you to maintain, monitor and troubleshoot production Kubernetes clusters.

items.human_name: Configuring and Managing Kubernetes Networking, Services, and Ingress
items.description: It's time to dig deeper into Kubernetes networking! You will learn Kubernetes cluster networking fundamentals and configuring and accessing applications in a Kubernetes Cluster with Services and Ingress.

items.human_name: Fundamentals of Docker and Kubernetes for .NET Developers
items.description: This course will teach you how to embrace Docker and Kubernetes within your .NET development efforts, including using Docker Compose to support SSL and a multi-project solution that includes a database.

items.description: Master strategy game mechanics for city-building games - all while creating your own from scratch! From underwater realms to medieval lands, survival games have become a popular staple among developers. You'll explore fundamental mechanics such as movement, needs, health, and a day-night cycle as you construct the beginnings of your very own survival game. These skills will form the core of your survival game projects and teach you universally relevant skills for all games. In this course, you'll explore the foundations of 3D RPG development in Unity by creating a simple micro-project where players can move around and attack enemies by clicking. These baseline mechanics will provide you with the fundamental knowledge you need to expand and build more complex 3D mechanics in the future. items.human_name: Construct a First Person Shooter in Unity

Through this course, you'll build your own FPS game in Unity while learning core mechanics for shooting, player movement, and similar. No matter how complex your planned features are, these FPS essentials will help put you on the path to building your dream FPS project! Additional features like cropping, rotating, and manual adjustments give you full control. Ideal for photographers and casual users, it simplifies photo enhancement with professional-grade results.

AI-based tone mapping, presets, and fine-tuned controls help achieve professional-grade results. Whether your photos suffer from motion blur, camera shake, or poor focus, the software uses multi-directional and adaptive methods to enhance sharpness. AI-powered algorithms help correct haze and fine-tune details for crisp, clear images. Perfect for professional photographers, it offers multiple modes and batch processing for large image collections. items.human_name: The Colour Out of Space - Miniatures Collection
items.description: Something has fallen from the stars onto the Gardner farm, twisting animals, plants and people around an impossible colour. This collection includes five mutated animals at 35–60 mm / 1.38–2.36 in, the Gardner family at 37–53 mm / 1.46–2.09 in, three mutated plants at 40–60 mm / 1.57–2.36 in and the 140 mm / 5.51 in Well-Colour centerpiece. Professionally pre-supported and print tested. Includes Pre-Supported STL, Unsupported STL and LYS files.

Whispered of through forbidden plays, strange symbols and decaying kingdoms, Hastur remains one of the Mythos’ most mysterious entities. This imposing King in Yellow miniature is supplied at 110 mm / 4.33 in and 75 mm / 2.95 in. The model is separated into multiple parts for easier printing, assembly and painting. Includes Pre-Supported and Unsupported STL files.

items.human_name: Cult of Nyarlathotep - Miniatures + Terrain Collection
items.description: Beneath the sands lies a forgotten cult devoted to Nyarlathotep, the Crawling Chaos. Build a complete Mythos encounter with the Black Pharaoh at 135 mm / 5.31 in and 75 mm / 2.95 in, a 135 mm / 5.31 in Shantak, four 40 mm / 1.57 in cultists and a towering 180 mm / 7.09 in temple gate. A full unsplit Black Pharaoh is also included. Professionally pre-supported and print tested. Includes Pre-Supported STL, Unsupported STL and LYS files.

Beyond the boundaries of time and space dwells Yog-Sothoth, the All-in-One and One-in-All. Bring this impossible cosmic entity to your tabletop as a striking centerpiece miniature. Yog-Sothoth measures 110 mm / 4.33 in and is separated into multiple parts for easier printing, assembly and painting. Includes Pre-Supported and Unsupported STL files.

items.human_name: Cult of Nyarlathotep Part 02 - Miniatures + Terrain Collection
items.description: The Crawling Chaos has countless faces. This second collection features the Haunter of the Dark at 150 mm / 5.91 in and 200 mm / 7.87 in, an Elder Thing at 75 mm / 2.95 in, four Serpent People and three Mi-Go at 40–50 mm / 1.57–1.97 in, plus the 50 mm / 1.97 in Shining Trapezohedron. A full unsplit Haunter is included. Professionally pre-supported and print tested. Includes Pre-Supported STL, Unsupported STL and LYS files.

items.human_name: The Dunwich Horror - Miniatures + Props Collection
items.description: Return to Dunwich and recreate one of Lovecraft’s most famous tales. This collection includes the 110 mm / 4.33 in Dunwich Horror; three versions of Wilbur Whateley; Lavinia and Old Whateley; investigators Henry Armitage, Francis Morgan and Warren Rice; plus four printable Necronomicon formats ranging from miniature and pendant versions to a life-size FDM prop with an internal compartment. Professionally pre-supported and print tested. Includes Pre-Supported STL, Unsupported STL and LYS files.

Unlike the distant gods of the Mythos, Nyarlathotep walks among mankind, taking countless forms and spreading madness in the service of the Outer Gods. This Crawling Chaos miniature is supplied at 110 mm / 4.33 in and 75 mm / 2.95 in. A full unsplit version is also included for one-piece printing. Includes Pre-Supported and Unsupported STL files.

Beyond the angles of ordinary reality dwell the Hounds of Tindalos, predators capable of pursuing prey across time itself. This pack includes Mh’ithrha, the Arch-Lord of Tindalos, at 95 mm / 3.74 in tall and 160 mm / 6.30 in long, plus three Hounds of Tindalos, each approximately 40 mm / 1.57 in tall and 75 mm / 2.95 in long. Includes printable STL files for all four creatures.

items.human_name: Father Dagon and Deep One Hybrids
items.description: From the black depths rises Father Dagon, ancient lord of the Deep Ones. This pack is ideal for aquatic Mythos encounters and coastal cults, combining Father Dagon at 110 mm / 4.33 in with three Deep One Hybrid miniatures at 32 mm / 1.26 in each. Models are separated where appropriate for easier printing, assembly and painting. Includes Pre-Supported and Unsupported STL files.

Revered and feared by those who worship the serpent, Yig is an ancient presence whose wrath follows anyone foolish enough to harm his children. Yig measures 120 mm / 4.72 in from base to head. Separate parts, a full model and combined body/base versions are included. Highly detailed for easy scaling or downscaling. Includes Pre-Supported and Unsupported STL files.

At the center of infinity lies the court of Azathoth, surrounded by impossible beings whose music echoes through the void. This collection includes Azathoth at 140 mm / 5.51 in, Ghroth at 130 mm / 5.12 in, Tru’nembra at 120 mm / 4.72 in, two Servitors of the Outer Gods at 50–70 mm / 1.97–2.76 in and three 50 mm / 1.97 in Flying Polyps. Professionally pre-supported and print tested. Includes Pre-Supported STL, Unsupported STL and LYS files.

items.human_name: Azathoth - The Lord of All Things
items.description: At the center of ultimate chaos writhes Azathoth, the blind cosmic entity before which reality itself seems insignificant. This centerpiece miniature is supplied at 110 mm / 4.33 in and 75 mm / 2.95 in. The model is separated for easier printing and painting, with letter markings on each tentacle to simplify assembly. Includes Pre-Supported and Unsupported STL files.

Across the frozen wastes stalks Ithaqua, a colossal entity carried through blizzards and howling winds. At 170 mm / 6.69 in from base to head, the Death-Walker makes a dramatic centerpiece for frozen horror encounters. Separate parts are supplied alongside full-model and combined body/base versions for larger single-piece prints. Includes Pre-Supported and Unsupported STL files.

items.human_name: Cult of Cthulhu - Miniatures + Terrain Collection
items.description: Cthulhu has awakened, and his followers gather as something ancient rises from beneath the sea. Build a complete Cthulhu-themed encounter with the Sleeper of R’lyeh at 150 mm / 5.91 in and 200 mm / 7.87 in, three 40 mm / 1.57 in tentacles, a 75 mm / 2.95 in Starspawn, four 40 mm / 1.57 in cultists, a sacrificial altar and temple terrain. A full unsplit Cthulhu is included. Professionally pre-supported and print tested. Includes Pre-Supported STL, Unsupported STL and LYS files.

Deep beneath the Pacific, Cthulhu lies dreaming in sunken R’lyeh. Bring one of cosmic horror’s most iconic entities to the tabletop with this imposing centerpiece miniature. Includes Cthulhu at 120 mm / 4.72 in, with Pre-Supported and Unsupported STL files. A full unsplit version is also included for those who prefer to print the model in one piece.

items.human_name: Shub-Niggurath - The Black Goat of the Woods with a Thousand Young
items.description: Deep within forgotten forests, Shub-Niggurath is worshipped as a monstrous force of fertility and corruption. This pack includes Shub-Niggurath at 110 mm / 4.33 in and 75 mm / 2.95 in, plus four Dark Young designs, each supplied at 32 mm / 1.26 in and 54 mm / 2.13 in. Models are separated where appropriate for easier printing and painting. Includes Pre-Supported and Unsupported STL files.

items.human_name: Tsathoggua - Sleeper of N'kai and Formless Spawns
items.description: Ancient, bloated and terrible, Tsathoggua waits in the darkness of N’kai while his amorphous servants crawl from the shadows. This encounter pack includes Tsathoggua at 120 mm / 4.72 in and three Formless Spawn miniatures at 32 mm / 1.26 in each. Models are separated where appropriate for easier printing and painting. Includes Pre-Supported and Unsupported STL files.

The rest is a myriad of mythological music to enliven your most Olympian projects or chart your path on the rainbow bridge!

From Victorian-inspired themes to pulsing investigative beats and spy-flavored soundscapes, it covers a wide range of settings and moods. A stylish collection for adding intrigue, tension, and personality to any mystery-driven project.

A strong choice for enhancing exploration, travel, and world-building moments.

Fuel your adventure with this 20-track JRPG and fantasy music pack designed for a wide range of gameplay moments. From towns and exploration to intense battles and dramatic encounters, it delivers a classic RPG feel with modern production. A versatile collection for building a rich, cohesive soundtrack across your entire game.

We've assembled a virtual zoo full of fantasy creatures to growl, snarl, and swipe their claws at the microphone so you can give voice to your own personal beastiary. Insectoids, aliens, creatures from the deep and powerful predators are all represented in the twenty four separate monsters (each with five or more sounds) that you will find in this pack. Wear protective gear and approach with caution.

A dynamic addition for games that want to amplify action, tension, and player feedback during battle.

Memorable melodies recall the classic soundtracks of the 16-bit and 32-bit console era and fill your game with nostalgic charm. Adventure, action and emotion fill this pack. Also includes twenty Music Events!

Expand your RPG soundtrack with this 20-track JRPG and fantasy collection, featuring a wide range of loopable themes for every stage of your adventure. From emotional story moments and peaceful towns to intense battles and heroic climaxes, it delivers a balanced mix of moods and styles. A strong follow-up pack for building a cohesive and dynamic game experience.

Drive your combat to new heights with this fantasy battle pack featuring 5 extended, loopable tracks built for intense encounters. Blending orchestral, rock, and metal influences, it delivers high-energy themes for boss fights, supernatural clashes, and chaotic magical battles. A focused collection for adding power, tension, and momentum to your game’s most critical moments.

Stir epic emotions with these ten tracks of orchestral fantasy music from composer Joel Steudler! Powerful themes for valiant heroes and evil antagonists are accompanied by evocative music for their journeys and battles. Let these powerful tracks take you to another time when the sword was mightier than... other things that were not swords.

With Latin-inspired phrases and a wide range of character voices, from heroes to dark entities, it lets you craft unique spell effects and abilities. A flexible toolkit for adding depth and personality to your game’s magic system.

From eerie ambience to intense, cinematic moments, each piece enhances exploration, suspense, and psychological dread. A strong addition for any horror project looking to build atmosphere and keep players on edge.

items.human_name: Debug Node Applications with Visual Studio Code
items.description: Debugging Node.js is not limited to using console.log. You can use more powerful and efficient tools like the built-in debugger within the Visual Studio Code editor.
Learn how to use Express.js to build dynamic websites on the Node.js platform. In the process, you'll learn some fundamental HTTP concepts that you can apply to any other framework!

In this workshop, we'll explore alternatives to if..then statements for controlling program flow. Even if you don't end up using them, you will see these forms appear in other code bases, and it's helpful to know how they work.
Learn to use React Router v6, a declarative routing solution for React, to manage the navigation and rendering of components in your applications.
Loops are a way of repeating code -- they're handy for repetitive tasks. Loops are frequently used for actions that need to run a particular number of times or until a certain condition is true.

Numbers are everywhere in programming. You use them to track a player's score in a game, calculate the cost of shipping a product, or count the number of times a "Like" button gets clicked on a page. In this course, you'll learn how to use numbers for useful tasks in your JavaScript programs, including doing math, converting strings to numbers, generating random numbers, and more.
In this course, you will learn how to implement the Basic Authentication scheme in a React application using an Express REST API.

Along with selecting DOM elements in JavaScript we can also write code that gives elements behavior. In this course we will first explore how to watch for interaction and respond using the method addEventListener. We'll learn about different types of events and how we can use the relationships between elements to write more powerful code.
Learn the basics of building out a REST API with Express, a popular framework written for Node.js.

items.human_name: Build a Simple Dynamic Site with Node.js
items.description: Node.js is a versatile platform for building all sorts of applications. In this course, we're going to make a dynamic website that displays a Treehouse student's profile information by creating a server that will dynamically generate content, handle URLs, read from files and build a simple template engine.

JavaScript is a programming language that drives the web: from front-end user interface design to server-side backend programming, you'll find JavaScript at every stage of a website and web application. In this course, you'll learn the fundamental programming concepts and syntax of the JavaScript programming language.

In SQL Basics, we’ll take a look at what databases are and how you can retrieve information from them. Databases can store massive amounts of information to be retrieved at a later date. Databases act as the memory for dynamic web sites or mobile apps.
JavaScript lets you create interactive web pages which can respond to a user's actions. In this course, you'll learn how to bring web pages to life using the power of JavaScript.

Objects are an essential part of JavaScript; they provide a flexible way to keep track of data by associating a name with a particular value. In this course, you'll learn the basics of JavaScript objects as a data structure (using objects to store key/value pairs).

Build an impressive portfolio with React that showcases your skills to potential employers. We'll start with provided styles and focus on creating components and adding interactivity. The portfolio will have a mobile-first design and be user-friendly for everyone. By the end, you'll have a simple yet impressive portfolio to show to potential employers.
In this workshop, you will use the Sequelize ORM and Express to build a simple CRUD application that's connected to a SQL database.
Practice initializing and managing state in React by building a star rating component.
In this course, you'll learn the basics of object-oriented programming in JavaScript along with the ES2015 Class syntax.
JavaScript functions let you create reusable chunks of code. They make programming faster, easier, and less error-prone. They are also one of the essential concepts in JavaScript programming.

Components are the core building blocks of a React application. This course will level-up your React skills by providing a better understanding of functional components, state and lifecycle methods, and how to split your UI into reusable and composable components.

items.human_name: How to Set Up a React App
items.description: React is a popular JavaScript library used for building user interfaces. In this workshop, you will learn how to set up a React app from scratch using Create React App and Vite. In this course, you'll learn step-by-step how to create a new React project, the starter files each built tool starts you off with and the default commands it comes with.
In this course, we’ll look more closely at three approaches to handling asynchronous operations in Express: callbacks, promises, and async/await.

JavaScript is everywhere and used in all phases of development from software to hardware. This course walks you through the modern landscape of JavaScript, and what it means to learn and program with JavaScript now and beyond.
In this workshop, learn how closures are used to preserve data between function calls.
In this course, you'll learn how to use the Sequelize ORM to leverage the power of SQL within your Node.js applications.
Practice your object-oriented JavaScript skills by building a fun and interactive 'Four in a Row' game.

AJAX is an important front-end web technology that lets JavaScript communicate with a web server. It lets you load new content without leaving the current page, creating a better, faster experience for your website's visitors. In this course, you'll learn how AJAX works and how you can use JavaScript to communicate with a web server. We'll use plain JavaScript to create AJAX requests and use the response to dynamically update your web pages. Along the way, you'll build mini-projects to reinforce your learning.
This workshop teaches you how to use the Fetch API to fetch resources.

items.human_name: Using npm as a Task Runner
items.description: In this workshop, we'll take a look at task running with npm, and learn how to set up npm to run tests.

Arrays provide a way to store multiple pieces of information. An array is a list of values: numbers, strings, boolean values, or even other arrays. In this course, you'll learn the basics of using arrays as data structures.
Sharpen your React skills by practicing JSX, creating and rendering components, passing down props, as well as iterating over data, and more.
Learn how to create a production build of your React application and deploy it to a server using free tools and services like Vercel and Netlify.
In this course, you will learn why asynchronous code matters and how to write code that avoids blocking behavior using three approaches: callbacks, promises, and async/await.

In the typical React data flow, components communicate with each other via props. A parent passes props down to child components. Sometimes the intermediary components get props passed to them with the sole purpose of passing that data down one (or several) more levels deep. This cascade of props is often referred to as "prop drilling". The React Context API provides a way to pass data to components without having to pass props manually at every single level.

At the heart of a dynamic application is a database. Whether the application is an eCommerce, sports team, social network, or productivity app on your phone, the data needs to change over time. In this course, we'll take a look at the underpinning SQL statements that are needed for every dynamic application.
Learn different methods for fetching external data in React, and how to display the data in your app.

React is a JavaScript library for building user interfaces. React makes building and maintaining your application's user interface faster and easier by breaking it up into smaller, reusable components. It also helps eliminate the complexity of updating your DOM elements when the user interacts with your application.

Presenting HEAT 2 - the original twin distortion powerhouse, now with a stunning refresh. This face-melting plugin features an intuitive new interface, more accurate frequency monitoring and a host of under-the-hood improvements.

An outstandingly beautiful Future Pop inspired pack that is 100% one of the best Future Pop sample packs on the market to date!

If you are wanting to create an uplifting and relaxing tropical house sound with the foundational elements of real house music, we welcome you to audio paradise with Tropical House Pleasure from Big EDM. Dive right into an oasis of catchy melodies shaped with an epic coastal influence. Start from scratch with any of the interchangeable audio samples or reconstruct a mix from any of the 12, yes 12, construction kits.

Puncher 2 is a Multi-FX plug-in that will add instant power and punch to your tracks. In terms of compression, this is the all in one tool you’ve been dreaming of. Packed into its compact design you will find 3 different effects.
Riddim has been a dominating genre in the EDM scene as of late, with names like Spag Heddy, Virtual Riot, Eh!de, Panda Eyes and Midnight Tyrannosaurus making big moves in the Riddim genre.

Nothing beats the tropics in the summer. Festivals, exotic food and drinks, the music is as endless as the sea. Big EDM is letting you take that experience with you with their latest release Tropical House Aroma. A sensational pack that is complete with all of the sounds you need to create your own Tropical House mix. Tropical House Aroma from Big EDM is inspired by such artists as Kygo, Thomas Jack, Sam Feldt, and Felix Jaehn.
Perfectly crafted by some of the worlds best producers and sound designers, Big EDM – Hexa Future Sounds is here to bring those high quality samples and presets as always.

For decades, audio engineers have used a certain processing trick on vocals to help lacklustre mono vocals leap from stereo speakers. Now you can replicate that secret technique with one simple plugin. Vocal Splitter is a handy one-stop unit for turning mono vocals into thick, modern-sounding stereo. When we developed this plugin we went one stage further, including frequency and drive parameters to help your vocal performances stand out from the crowd. Of course, you can also this plugin on audio other than vocals... download the demo and give it a try.

Whether you're composing a film score, building an epic EDM track, or working on your new viral TikTok video, cinematic FX sounds can be incredible tools for creating drama, suspense, and impactful moods of all kinds. However, the quality of these sounds is key, which is why we tasked our top-quality experts with creating one of our best FX packs ever -- What About: Cinematic FX!

For a vocal to really cut through the mix and ride other instruments, it’s usually a good idea to make sure it’s loud and proud. However, the dynamics of a vocalist’s performance can vary wildly, from softly sung verses to strident choruses. Despite a comprehensive vocal effects chain, with careful volume-riding and compression, you’ll often need a final limiter to clamp down on fluctuating dynamics or to smooth slower phrases.

The violin is a classic instigator of all types of emotions. From suspense to tragedy. Twangy and upbeat to totally staccato (unpredictable). A violin quivers and pierces with galvanizing shrieks, and like the changing of a chameleons colors, it morphs into a sound that is elegantly beautiful and inspiring. Big EDM has captured the essence of the violin and paired it with a wide variety of complimentary electro synth, bass, and drum sounds.

Orchestral sounds can breathe fresh life into songs of any genre due to their universal popularity and organic construction. But getting high-quality, realistic orchestral sounds can often be a challenge. That's why we're bringing you this sequel to one of our most popular packs -- What About: Dramatic Orchestra Toolkit 2!
Introducing Big EDM – Melodic Deep Voodoo, a pack that is jam packed full of crazy melodic sounds that will being an intense and deep feel to your tracks.

The first step in the chain is often compression, but with so many different types of compressors to choose from which is the perfect solution for your vocals? We’ve created Vocal Compressor to solve that problem, featuring a compression chain that’s transparent, balanced and adds subtle flavour, colour and grit to make vocals sit perfectly in a mix.

As a famous vocalist once sang, “It’s all about the bass” and in as far as most genres of music are concerned, she’d be correct! Bass line balancing has always been a big challenge for producers, especially at the mixing stage, as the dynamic range of low end material can be huge.

Are you ready to get retro and slide into synthwave? We present to you What About: Synthwave Arcade sample pack. These are the sounds you’ve never heard before. A modern fusion of old-school classic sounds blended together in a way that has never been done before. We’ve got the funk of nu-disco, the past future atmosphere from the 80’s, and rhythmically thumping retro wave synths giving you this inventive hybrid spin on synthwave.
Ever have a creative stand still? Check out What About: EDM Assault. This pack is going to spark the creativity and give your sound a true unique and individual touch.

The dark, heavy, and futuristic sounds often found in Bass Music can also be some of the most complex to create. But if you don’t have hours to spend on designing a single sound, what are your options? Well, you’re in luck, because that’s precisely why we created What About: Cybernetic Bass Music!

We've been getting a lot of requests for tools suitable for more relaxed musical styles, so we were inspired to create What About: Electric Chill for you all!

This beautifully comprised pack contains 5 construction kits that paint a vast landscape with vibrant upbeat sounds that are sure to inspire your creativity and refresh any stagnant projects.

Click. Confirm. Play. Direct player engagement with responsive digital feedback. Crisp interface beeps, tactile button clicks, immersive arcade ambience, and slick screen transitions. Perfect for menus, notifications, and HUD interactions. Design an experience players feel.
The rattle of a stagecoach, the crackle of a campfire guitar tune-up, the raw energy of a vintage cattle drive. This is the gritty, authentic atmosphere of the West, with no cliché.

Shadowy. Suspenseful. Unfinished business. Tense pulses, uneasy strings, and the weight of a case that won't close. From solemn, bitter confessions to aggressive newsroom chases and stealthy night moves, this is the sound of cracked leather chairs, cold coffee, and one last lead. Perfect for crime docs, mystery podcasts, thriller trailers, and creators who deal in secrets, lies, and slow-burn tension. Trust no one.

Soft, tender pianos and warm strings whisper vulnerability and longing. Gentle cello lines and delicate acoustic guitars add depth and reflection. Some tracks bloom with quiet hope, others linger in bittersweet memory or sorrow. From wedding vows to farewells, first glances to last goodbyes — this is the sound of hearts on screen, scored with restraint, grace, and emotional truth.

"Galactic Communication Arrays" is a pack of otherworldly signals and sci-fi transmissions, featuring encrypted data bursts, pulsating alien beacons, and warped digital interference—crafting the sound of unknown hails, deep-space telemetry, and the mysterious language of distant technology.

This collection embodies the highest standards of musical excellence, featuring elegant minuets, dramatic symphonic movements, and profound operatic interludes. It is the definitive resource for projects requiring an air of cultivated sophistication, profound emotional depth, and unwavering prestige.

"Biotech & Experiments" is a pack of laboratory and scientific sound effects for sci-fi. It features bubbling vats, centrifuge hums, data-stream pulses, and ominous machinery—crafting the sterile, precise, and sometimes unnerving atmosphere of research labs, alien autopsies, and experimental biotech facilities.

"Cultures of the Spiral Arm" is a world music collection for building alien societies and intergalactic cultures. This collection blends earthy textures—from ceremonial African drums and meditative Asian flutes to Celtic pipes and Latin grooves—to score vibrant alien marketplaces, serene diplomatic encounters, and the distinct spirit of civilizations across the stars. Perfect for grounded, character-rich sci-fi with soul.

Forty professionally crafted acoustic rock tracks designed for broadcast, corporate, and commercial applications. Featuring warm, well-mixed guitars, solid rhythmic foundations, and tasteful arrangements that avoid overproduction. The collection spans upbeat, driving anthems suitable for promotional content and lifestyle branding, as well as more restrained, introspective ballads for narrative-driven projects.

A curated collection of 20 atmospheric sounds perfect for enhancing interviews and narrative projects. Features vintage vibraphone accents, subtle whooshes, library ambience, sci-fi tones, and delicate glass sounds. Ideal for documentaries, podcasts, or adding vintage/ethereal flavor to stories.

Haunted Harmonies is a symphony of shadow and spectacle, merging brutal orchestral force with eerie, supernatural atmosphere. From apocalyptic battles and cursed revelations to sinister magic shows and heroic struggles against the void, this collection is forged for epic horror, dark fantasy, and trailers where light fights to survive the fall.

A time capsule of classic cool, blending swaggering '80s rock, pulsing synthwave, and iconic TV themes. From confident intros and tense detective cues to smooth tropical escapes, this collection is your secret weapon for throwback commercials, retro gaming, and content that demands authentic vintage flair. Rewind the clock. Make it classic.

A sound designer's essential arsenal of precision and texture. This delivers raw, modular components—harsh zaps, turbulent whooshes, and gritty risers. Sculpt unique moments with LFE-driven feedback, glitched accents, and metallic stings. Build everything from sci-fi interfaces to visceral impacts. For the architects of sound.

Parallel Dimensions & Drift Energy – an SFX pack of unstable reality. Get portal whooshes, tonal oscillations, and heavy modulations for alternate timelines, unstable rifts, and sci-fi experiments with time and space.

items.human_name: World Ambiences: Middle East & Asian Sounds
items.description: You'll hear the sacred resonance of large Islamic bowls and temple bells, the focused energy of small groups chanting in Arabic, and the distant, solemn prayers of monks. It moves from the vibrant, crowded atmosphere of a Hebrew and Arabic marketplace to the intense, seething energy of a large exterior crowd. The sounds range from intimate, pointed conversations and laughter to the vast, dynamic winds of the desert—capturing the region's profound spiritual depth and vibrant public life.

"The Quiet Between Stars" is a smooth jazz and ambient sound set for introspective sci-fi moments. This collection of cool piano, smoky bass lines, and intimate ballads scores the quiet human connections in deep space—lonely station bars, late-night contemplation, and the soulful undercurrent of life aboard a long-haul starship.

From bittersweet solo piano and brooding western regret to spacey, contemplative drones and subtle romantic undertones, it’s the essential score for character-driven dramas, festival shorts, and narratives that thrive on raw, emotional authenticity. Tell the quiet stories.

Beginnings are tender, hesitant, often uncertain — pianos and strings whispering doubt, loss, or longing. Then, gradually, something shifts. Layers accumulate. Percussion enters. Melodies rise. Hope doesn't arrive suddenly — it builds. These tracks understand that healing, grief, love, and recovery take time. Perfect for narratives that respect emotional complexity and the slow work of becoming whole.

Raw factory energy. Heavy machinery roar, stamping presses, clanking pipes, and hissing gas lines. From massive production halls to empty, dripping warehouses—this is the sound of steel, steam, and sweat. Perfect for dystopian worlds, cyberpunk scenes, tech breakdowns, and any creator who wants their content to hit with industrial weight. No polish. Just power.

Sneaky pizzicato strings, wobbly ragtime pianos, and clumsy chase scenes. Saucy jazz, hipster whistling, and circus daredevils with no net. This collection doesn't take itself seriously—and neither should you. Perfectly timed pratfalls, raised eyebrows, and that "oops" moment we've all been there. Slapstick sketches, quirky vlogs, animated bloopers, and creators who know when to wink at the camera. No drama. Just giggles.

This collection crafts a profound sense of isolation and haunting atmosphere. It moves from the lonely, fluorescent hum of a late-night gas station to the eerie, empty drones of alien hives and cavernous industrial spaces. Layer in the dissonant ambience of rainy city alleys, the distant echo of an empty hallway, and the isolated rumble of a dormant volcano for deeply atmospheric, melancholic scenes.

This 50-track collection covers it all: ambient backgrounds like city traffic, forest birds, desert wind, and airport bustle; everyday sounds like keyboard typing, camera clicks, doorbells, and footsteps on dirt and concrete; plus punchy production elements including game show buzzers, dramatic symphonic hits, suspense accents, magic sparkles, crowd applause, thunder crashes, glass breaks, explosions, and even a 9 mm handgun shot. Whether you're telling true crime, storytelling fiction, comedy, or commentary, these sound effects add instant energy and immersion.

Listen to a curated set of positive human responses, from the sharp, collective gasp of surprise and light, contagious laughter to energetic cheers and supportive "yeahs." Perfect for studio audiences, courtroom victories, or any scene needing a genuine lift, it captures the immediate, positive energy of a engaged group.

The sound of living. Raw, real, and uncomfortably close. Toaster pops, scissors snip, keys drop, and the refrigerator breathes in the dark. From buzzing doorbells and ringing flip phones to hissing gas stoves and grinding coffee machines—this isn't a home makeover. It's the messy, mechanical, sometimes annoying pulse of everyday life. Perfect for ASMR, relatable creator skits, horror hidden in plain sight, or anyone who wants to make the ordinary feel loud. Welcome home.

Warm. Nostalgic. Joyfully familiar. Jingle bells, silent nights, and sugar plum fairies. Triumphant choruses, gentle lullabies, and playful elf antics. Crackling fireplaces, sparkling music boxes, and the quiet magic of snowfall. This collection captures every shade of the season—from solemn reverence to exuberant celebration. Holiday content, family videos, retail playlists, and creators spreading cheer.

Real stories need real feeling — not overproduced Hollywood bombast. This collection is for the quiet moments, the honest conversations, the slow walks through old neighborhoods. Fifty tracks of gentle pianos, warm strings, mellow guitars, and understated electronics that breathe instead of push. Hopeful but not cheesy.

Alien Jam – a playlist of otherworldly life. Get alien creature growls, insectoid chirps, heavy alien breaths, and interdimensional snarls. Soundtrack your xenomorph hive, jungle planet ambush, or first contact gone wrong.

This collection builds atmosphere with the gentle crackle of a fireplace, the soft patter of rain against a window, and the peaceful rhythm of a steady stream. Layer in the distant rumble of a highway from a cozy cabin, the delicate sound of falling autumn leaves, and the subtle textures of a grassy room tone to create deeply tranquil, reassuring environments.

Explosions, creatures, drones - oh my! Bring big-budget quality to your game with the Game Developer Sound Effects Pack. This treasure trove of assets lets you craft immersive worlds that pop. With dark, gritty audio like shatters and impacts, you can amp up the action. Cinematic whooshes build suspense during stealth scenes. And vocalizations, pulsing tones, and eerie ambiances set an unsettling mood. The pack includes 50 clips of: hard-hitting combat sounds, sci-fi tones for high-tech scenes, creature vocals that send chills, cracks, rumbles, and booms, drones, risers, and swells.

"Retro Futures" is a collection of vintage synth and lo-fi cues for classic, low-budget sci-fi atmosphere. This bundle captures the eerie, analog charm of 70s/80s sci-fi with pulsing electronics, suspenseful drones, and cassette-tape tension—perfect for cosmic mysteries, eerie alien signals, and nostalgic space exploration.

From rumbling subway tunnels and bustling train stations to the hum of city buses and Venice’s water taxis — this playlist captures the heartbeat of global transit. Each track drops you into real motion: airport crowds, street traffic with police horses, windy terminals, and even a Buenos Aires bus ride. Perfect for filmmakers, game designers, or anyone needing authentic, immersive transportation ambience with character and depth.

The secret sauce for authentic content! Get real-life sounds every creator needs: camera shutter clicks for travel vlogs, coffee machine bubbles for morning routines, gym sounds for fitness content, and fancy champagne pops for celebration scenes. Perfect for content creators who want their videos to feel alive and unscripted. No more fake stock sounds – just real moments captured.

Silly. Chaotic. Gloriously unhinged. Boings, slide whistles, rubbery sproings, and xylophone trills that defy logic. Magical sparkles. Falling anvils. Squeaky horn toots. Chipmunk giggles. This isn't subtle—it's the sound of someone getting hit in the face with a pie, shaking it off, and doing it again. Animation, comedy sketches, meme content, game night intros, creators who aren't afraid to look ridiculous. No rules. No dignity. Just fun.

Deep Space Phenomena" is a sound design toolkit for sci-fi isolation and cosmic mystery. This collection features sonar pings, deep drones, garbled transmissions, and metallic echoes to build immersive ambiences of derelict ships, alien signals, and the unnerving silence between stars. Perfect for atmospheric tension and world-building in the void.

Explosive New Year’s cheers, car-honking street festivals, bustling Christmas malls, and the walla of packed pubs. Layer in the iconic pop of champagne and the roaring crowd of a stadium to build instantly festive, high-energy scenes.
Get access to over 300,000 tracks of royalty-free music and sound effects with Tier 1, which gives you one track of your choice for your next project.

This electro pop music playlist features a dynamic mix of uplifting, modern house, trap, ethereal, electronic, and inspirational dance music. With a fusion of different genres, this playlist offers a diverse range of tracks that are perfect for creating a lively and energetic atmosphere. Whether you're looking to get pumped up for a workout or simply want to elevate your mood, this playlist is sure to keep you moving and grooving!
"Sci-Fi Labs" is a group of sounds for futuristic labs. It includes bubbling experiments, humming machines, laser zaps, and the noise of lab disasters—perfect for building a science outpost in space.

"Analog Horizons in VHS" is a retro synth & rock set for gritty, vintage sci-fi. This collection captures the raw, pulsing energy of 80s-inspired synthtracks and confident guitar riffs—perfect for analog spacecraft, low-tech cybernetics, and cassette-future adventures. Think cathode-ray mysteries and synthwave heroics.

An earth-stained Celtic anthems and haunting medieval elegies. From raw, percussive pagan rhythms and mournful pipe melodies to noble, battle-worn resolve, this is the score for a darker epic—think brutal strategy games, gritty historical dramas, and fantasy with blood on its sword.

This collection is the soundtrack to victory—bold anthems for big dreams, quiet resolve for the long climb, and explosive releases for the moment you make it. Corporate presentations, sports highlights, documentary climaxes, and anyone chasing something greater. No quitting. Just rising.

"Space & Void" is a pack of cosmic ambiences and stellar atmospheres, featuring weightless drones, solar wind howls, and distant stellar rumbles. This builds the vast, haunting soundscape of deep space, from desolate planetary surfaces to the silent presence of distant stars.

Built for high-octane sports highlights, intense gameplay montages, and any scene that demands raw, unfiltered power. This is the sound of rebellion, competition, and pure adrenaline. Smash the ceiling.

"The Grand Fleet" is an epic orchestral list for colossal sci-fi warfare and naval might. This collection features majestic brass, thunderous percussion, and heroic marches—perfect for massive fleet deployments, historic space battles, and the awe-inspiring spectacle of an interstellar armada.
